svg.aria-label: What I've shipped. From first commit to production, end to end. Live location sharing: SOS alerts, timed shares, live maps, press-and-hold SMS safety, and the activity feed around them. iOS app (Capacitor): Keyboard handling, native map lifecycle, CSV preview and download, layout polish. Product-led growth: JobPosting structured data, sitemaps, Search Console, Wikidata entity linking, local discovery pages. Infrastructure: Google Cloud Build deploy scripts, GitHub Actions workflows, build-time configuration. Consent and data: Consent-response validation, PII sanitizing in observability, people search accuracy. Test coverage: Vitest suites for routing, navigation and utility modules, plus edge-case characterization.
